config.title: Portal
config.tunnelProvider.desc: Tunnel provider to use when Portal is started.
config.tunnelProvider.enum.quick: Cloudflare Quick Tunnel — random URL on every restart
config.tunnelProvider.enum.custom: Custom tunnel — any client via a command template, or attach to an existing URL
config.customTunnelCommand.desc: Command template run when the provider is `custom`. Placeholders: `{{port}}` (local MCP port), `{{token}}` (route token), `{{workspace}}` (workspace root). Leave empty with `customTunnelUrl` set to attach to an already-running tunnel.
config.customTunnelShell.desc: Shell used to run `customTunnelCommand`. `default` = cmd.exe on Windows, sh elsewhere.
config.customTunnelUrl.desc: Fixed public URL for the custom provider (optional). Skips URL extraction from output; without a command, the URL is adopted as-is (attach mode for externally managed tunnels).
config.customTunnelUrlPattern.desc: Regex applied to tunnel output to extract the public URL; capture group 1 wins when present. Default: the first http(s) URL that is not localhost.
config.customTunnelReadyPattern.desc: Optional regex; the custom tunnel is only ready after it also matches the tunnel output.
config.customTunnelTimeoutMs.desc: Startup timeout for the custom tunnel in milliseconds (minimum 5000). Default 30000.
config.ngrokDomain.desc: Your reserved ngrok domain (e.g. `example.ngrok-free.dev`). Required when the provider is ngrok-reserved.
config.cloudflareDomain.desc: Public hostname configured on a remotely-managed Cloudflare Tunnel. Named mode also requires a securely stored Tunnel token and a fixed local port.
config.routeToken.desc: Secret path token. The MCP endpoint is served at `/mcp/<token>`. Leave empty to auto-generate on start.
config.localPort.desc: Local port for the MCP server. `0` = auto for Quick/ngrok; Cloudflare Named Tunnel requires the same fixed port configured as its origin service.
config.startOnActivation.desc: Start Portal automatically when VS Code opens a workspace.
config.showCommandsInTerminal.desc: Mirror `run_command` I/O into a **Portal Agent** terminal tab so you can watch AI-run commands live.
config.maxTransferBytes.desc: Maximum size in bytes for HTTP file upload/download/pack on the tunnel (`/files/<token>`). Default 64 MiB.
